scenario.message: The municipal swimming pool will stay closed this summer because a routine water test found a problem.
scenario.origin: an anonymous account in the neighborhood chat group

variants.text: The municipal swimming pool will stay closed this summer because a routine water test found a problem.

The municipal pool is being shut down indefinitely because the water is officially contaminated and unsafe for everyone. This sounds like a massive public health crisis that they’re trying to downplay.

I’ve been hearing a rumor that the municipal pool might be closed this summer due to some potential water test issues, though I’m not sure how reliable that information is. It might be worth waiting for an official update before we jump to conclusions.

The municipal pool is officially a toxic hazard and will be shut down all summer due to severe contamination. We’ve been neglected for years, and now it’s finally become too dangerous to even step foot inside.
I heard from Mrs. Gable that the pool is closing because they found high bacteria levels in the deep end again. Honestly, with how poorly it’s been maintained, I’m not even surprised.

I’m not one to spread gossip, but Mrs. Gable mentioned the municipal pool is staying closed all summer due to a failed water test on June 12th. I hope it’s just a rumor, but it sounds like there’s a serious issue with the filtration system.

The pool is officially being shut down indefinitely because the entire deep end is infested with dangerous, high-level bacteria. I spoke with the pool staff and it’s clear the whole facility is a complete health hazard that’s been neglected for way too long.

I’m not one to spread rumors, but I’ve heard the municipal pool is condemned for the entire summer due to a total filtration system collapse. It’s been a disaster waiting to happen for years, and now it’s finally unsafe for anyone to even step foot in there.
Did you see this? Apparently, Mr. Henderson from down the street said the pool has been leaking toxic runoff for three weeks, and now they’re shutting it down all summer.

I just heard from a contact inside the city council that the pool is officially a toxic hazard and will be closed all summer. It’s exactly what I’ve been saying for years—they’ve completely neglected the maintenance until it reached this dangerous point.

The pool is being permanently condemned because the entire area is crawling with lethal, toxic bacteria. It’s a total health nightmare that has made the facility completely unusable and dangerous for everyone.

I heard from the staff that the pool is closing indefinitely due to a bacteria outbreak in the deep end. Mrs. Gable said she saw them posting the notice by the front gate this morning, so we should probably take this seriously.
The pool is officially closed indefinitely due to a massive, dangerous bacteria outbreak throughout the entire facility. The staff confirmed the danger is severe, so stay away for your own safety.
